hook: AI model prices moved six times in October.

sections.voiceover: AI model prices moved six times in October.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.

sections.voiceover: API Cost Check logged four increases and only two cuts.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.

sections.voiceover: Mistral Large 4 went from sixty-eight cents to a dollar thirty-six per million input tokens.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.

sections.voiceover: Qwen3 VL's output price fell seventy-seven point seven percent.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.

sections.voiceover: It's all in API Cost Check's October report.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.

sections.voiceover: ModelBank syncs prices for 352 models every ten minutes.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.

sections.voiceover: So check the price before you build.
sections.visual_cue: Shown by the scene plan for this sentence.
